entity_types.name: Vehicle
entity_types.description: The vehicle a complaint document is about, named as in the text or the document name, excluding its parts.

entity_types.name: Component
entity_types.description: A part or system of the vehicle that the text names, excluding the symptoms it shows.

entity_types.name: Problem
entity_types.description: A malfunction, defect or unwanted behaviour the text reports, or an event it leads to, excluding the part itself.

entity_types.name: Recall
entity_types.description: A safety recall campaign that the text names, excluding the complaint itself.

fact_types.description: The text reports the problem in this part or system, also when it names the part only in a when-clause.
The text reports the problem for the vehicle without naming a part.
The text says the first problem leads to the second problem or event.
The text says a failure of this part leads to the problem or event.
The text names a recall that covers this part.
A named part belongs to the vehicle the document is about.
